title: Southern Caviar
description: A simple and delicious dip made with black-eyed peas, corn, Rotel, red onion, and zesty Italian dressing.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
notes:
This recipe was created in a humorous, fictional setting and the ingredients were gathered in an airport. The author tried black-eyed peas for the first time while making this recipe.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1PQbnLsJ4k/

Nutrition: Serving 1/4 cup · Calories 150 · Fat 7g · Saturated fat 1g · Unsaturated fat 6g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 0mg · Sodium 400mg · Carbs 20g · Fiber 3g · Sugar 5g · Protein 3g

healthy: Black-eyed peas give fiber and plant protein.
Corn, tomatoes, chilies and red onion add vegetables.
not_healthy: Canned beans, corn, Rotel and Italian dressing add sodium.
Bottled dressing adds some sugar and oil.
